scope: Saved Massassi Discord discussion relevant to JKDF2/MotS character and weapon models; excludes level design.
coverage_note: Date bounds describe saved searches, not a complete search result set. All captured channel texts were screened; relevant candidates and local surrounding replies were read. Empty and repeated captures do not enlarge coverage.

extraction_corrections.issue: Quoted reply text can populate convenience body instead of the author's own reply.
extraction_corrections.method: Read the own author/header and following content in full text.

extraction_corrections.issue: A quoted edited-message timestamp can populate convenience time.
extraction_corrections.method: Use the selected message's own complete header and retain its display timezone as unspecified.

source_strength_policy: Participant testimony, proposals, acknowledgments, source-code mechanism and prior project measurements are distinguished; none is newly reproduced runtime evidence.
rights: Concise original technical synthesis and attribution only; no full chats, signed attachment URLs, private paths, images or game assets are included.
